documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: In Q3 FY26, Bajaj Auto achieved an all-time high top line exceeding INR 15,000 crores, registering a 19% year-on-year growth driven by broad-based performance across domestic and export markets. Quarterly EBITDA crossed INR 3,100 crores with a margin of 20.8%, supported by favorable currency realization, operating leverage, and PLI benefits. The EV business delivered double-digit EBITDA margins and accounted for 25% of domestic revenues. Management expects the domestic motorcycle industry to sustain a 12% to 15% growth rate and aims to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects the motorcycle industry to continue growing at 12% to 15% in the near term.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects sustained growth tempo in its exports business in the coming months.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months.

guidance.claim: The exports business is on track to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms in this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Post-GST rationalization, Q3 motorcycle industry sales grew by approximately 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, slipping to minus 3% in Q2. But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: GST cuts lifted the 3-wheeler ICE segment growth to positive 4% to 5%.
demand_outlook.quote: The ICE segment was declining in April-August period by about 4%, but GST cuts have bumped up growth to positive 4% to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric 3-wheeler segment continues to grow at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

capex_expansion.claim: Chetak's retail network expanded to 450 exclusive stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.
capex_expansion.quote: The scale-up was also supported by distribution network that expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand joint KTM-Triumph showrooms to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto increased its ownership in KTM Austria to 75% effective November 18.
capex_expansion.quote: Effective November 18, Bajaj ownership in KTM Austria increased to 75% and a turnaround plan was commenced immediately, which has 3 main elements to it: number one, ensure liquidity.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA reached over INR 3,100 crores with an EBITDA margin of 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at over INR3,100 crores at 20.8%, another all-time high and PAT crossed INR2,500 crores, yet another all-time high.

margins_costs.claim: Net price versus cost inflation caused a margin hit of nearly 50 basis points in Q3.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: The EV business delivers a double-digit EBITDA margin.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: Bajaj Auto initiated pricing actions at the start of Q4 to cover half of an anticipated 50 to 60 basis points cost inflation impact.
margins_costs.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports volume surpassed 600,000 units in Q3 for the first time in 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Pro-Biking domestic volumes reached a record combined high of over 35,000 units in Q3.
orders_capacity.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto closed Q3 with surplus cash of approximately INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow generated during the first 9 months of the financial year reached nearly INR 5,200 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto invested over INR 2,300 crores into its Netherlands subsidiary during the 9-month period.
capital_allocation.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced cost pressures across noble metals and base metals like aluminium and copper.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives resulted in an adverse impact of INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per electric 3-wheeler.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: A one-time exceptional charge of INR 61 crores was recorded due to revised wage definitions under the new labour code.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto will execute 8 additional product interventions in its Pulsar portfolio over the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand its joint KTM-Triumph showroom count to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to scale up the Riki brand footprint starting from quarter 1.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start to scale up Riki beginning quarter 1.

management_commitments.claim: Starting next quarter, the KTM business will be fully consolidated line-by-line into Bajaj Auto's financial results.
management_commitments.quote: However, from the next quarter onwards, the KTM business will be fully consolidated into our results on a line-by-line basis as is required for subsidiaries.
